correctness.rationale: Occurrence positions are partitioned by their first selected one. The preceding-zero count profile yields an exact weighted sum of positive binomial terms, bounding both the number of post-boundary ones and the final constrained zero count. Unique factorization into a+b unrestricted zero/one gap slots yields precisely z^(q+t_r)/(1-z)^(a+b) for each profile. Since the numerator has nonnegative coefficients and evaluates to the positive profile count at z=1, each attainable positive frequency has eventual degree exactly a+b-1. Independent word-level dynamic-programming enumeration matched the formula in 3,168 cells; no infinite conclusion rests on finite checks.
